mapper.select: SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY menu_id

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.dept_id AS deptId, u.status FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.dept_id AS deptId FROM sys_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 100
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY ur.user_id

SELECT id, role_name, role_key, sort, status, remark, data_scope, visible_modules, tenant_id, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM sys_role WHERE id = #{roleId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
